shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '*Navigation*' -g '*nav*' | head -80 && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- Navigation ---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/Navigation.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- app files ---' && find app -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sort && printf '%s\\n' '--- Link docs candidates ---' && rg -l \"next/link|<Link|Link Component\" node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- page ---' && sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- layout ---' && sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- current Link guidance ---' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md"
